+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.set_global_product_composition_core(p_produto_id uuid, p_expected_updated_at timestamp with time zone, p_status text, p_itens jsonb, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE v_actor uuid; v_req jsonb; v_replay jsonb; v_receipt jsonb; v_audit uuid := gen_random_uuid();
+  v_op public.produtos%ROWTYPE; v_np public.produtos%ROWTYPE; v_e jsonb; v_i int := 0; v_n int;
+  v_before jsonb; v_after jsonb; v_form_before text; v_form_after text; v_vol_before text; v_vol_after text;
+  v_old_status text; v_keys text[] := ARRAY['base','componente_nome','microrganismo_id','natureza','ordem','quantidade','tipo_componente','unidade'];
+BEGIN
+  v_actor := platform_private.catalog_metadata_require_actor();
+  IF p_produto_id IS NULL OR p_expected_updated_at IS NULL OR NOT pg_catalog.isfinite(p_expected_updated_at) OR p_idempotency_key IS NULL
+     OR p_status IS NULL OR p_status NOT IN ('rascunho','completo')
+     OR p_itens IS NULL OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(p_itens) <> 'array' OR pg_catalog.jsonb_array_length(p_itens) > 50
+     OR (p_status = 'completo' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_array_length(p_itens) = 0) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_composition_invalid'; END IF;
+  -- Formato estrito de cada item (chaves exatas, tipos JSON, ordem 1..n sequencial). Valores finais validados pelos CHECKs.
+  FOR v_e IN SELECT e FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(p_itens) e LOOP
+    v_i := v_i + 1;
+    IF pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(v_e) <> 'object'
+       OR (SELECT pg_catalog.array_agg(k ORDER BY k) FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_object_keys(v_e) k) IS DISTINCT FROM v_keys
+       OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(v_e->'ordem') <> 'number' OR (v_e->>'ordem') <> v_i::text
+       OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(v_e->'quantidade') NOT IN ('number','null')
+       OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(v_e->'tipo_componente') <> 'string' OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(v_e->'natureza') <> 'string'
+       OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(v_e->'microrganismo_id') NOT IN ('string','null')
+       OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(v_e->'componente_nome') NOT IN ('string','null')
+       OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(v_e->'unidade') NOT IN ('string','null') OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(v_e->'base') NOT IN ('string','null')
+       OR (v_e->>'microrganismo_id') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND v_e->>'microrganismo_id' IS NOT NULL
+       OR (p_status = 'completo' AND v_e->>'quantidade' IS NULL) THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_composition_invalid'; END IF;
+    -- No máximo 6 casas decimais (numeric(24,6) arredondaria silenciosamente).
+    IF v_e->>'quantidade' IS NOT NULL AND pg_catalog.scale((v_e->>'quantidade')::numeric) > 6 THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_composition_invalid'; END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  v_req := pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('produto_id',p_produto_id,'expected_updated_at',p_expected_updated_at,'status',p_status,
+    'itens',p_itens,'reason',pg_catalog.btrim(COALESCE(p_reason,'')));
+  v_replay := platform_private.catalog_entity_replay(v_actor,'set_global_product_composition',v_req,p_reason,p_idempotency_key);
+  IF v_replay IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN v_replay; END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_op FROM public.produtos WHERE id = p_produto_id FOR UPDATE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501', MESSAGE='catalog_composition_unavailable'; END IF;
+  IF v_op.updated_at IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_updated_at THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='catalog_composition_conflict'; END IF;
+  IF v_op.familia_catalogo IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_composition_requires_family'; END IF;
+
+  -- Família transacional (após lock) e regras cruzadas com a receita.
+  FOR v_e IN SELECT e FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(p_itens) e LOOP
+    IF NOT platform_private.catalog_composition_type_allowed(v_op.familia_catalogo, v_e->>'tipo_componente') THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514', MESSAGE='catalog_composition_family_conflict'; END IF;
+    IF v_e->>'tipo_componente' = 'microrganismo' THEN
+      -- Nova associação exige micro ativo; micro já declarado (mesmo arquivado depois) pode ser mantido.
+      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.microrganismos m WHERE m.id = (v_e->>'microrganismo_id')::uuid
+          AND (m.ativo OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.produto_composicao_declaracoes d
+                 WHERE d.produto_id = p_produto_id AND d.microrganismo_id = m.id))) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_composition_micro_unavailable'; END IF;
+      IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.formulacoes f WHERE f.produto_id = p_produto_id
+          AND f.microrganismo_id = (v_e->>'microrganismo_id')::uuid AND f.concentracao IS NOT NULL) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514', MESSAGE='catalog_composition_duplicate_measure'; END IF;
+    END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+
+  SELECT c.status INTO v_old_status FROM public.produto_composicao_conjuntos c WHERE c.produto_id = p_produto_id FOR UPDATE;
+  SELECT COALESCE(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('ordem',d.ordem,'tipo_componente',d.tipo_componente,
+      'microrganismo_id',d.microrganismo_id,'componente_nome',d.componente_nome,'quantidade',d.quantidade,'unidade',d.unidade,
+      'base',d.base,'natureza',d.natureza) ORDER BY d.ordem), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_before
+    FROM public.produto_composicao_declaracoes d WHERE d.produto_id = p_produto_id;
+  SELECT md5(COALESCE(string_agg(pg_catalog.to_jsonb(f)::text, ',' ORDER BY f.id), '')) INTO v_form_before FROM public.formulacoes f WHERE f.produto_id = p_produto_id;
+  SELECT md5(COALESCE(string_agg(pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v)::text, ',' ORDER BY v.id), '')) INTO v_vol_before FROM public.catalogo_volumes v WHERE v.produto_id = p_produto_id;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.produto_composicao_conjuntos (produto_id, status, updated_by) VALUES (p_produto_id, p_status, v_actor)
+  ON CONFLICT (produto_id) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by;
+  DELETE FROM public.produto_composicao_declaracoes d WHERE d.produto_id = p_produto_id;
+  INSERT INTO public.produto_composicao_declaracoes (produto_id, ordem, tipo_componente, microrganismo_id, componente_nome, quantidade, unidade, base, natureza)
+  SELECT p_produto_id, (e->>'ordem')::smallint, e->>'tipo_componente', (e->>'microrganismo_id')::uuid, e->>'componente_nome',
+         (e->>'quantidade')::numeric, e->>'unidade', e->>'base', e->>'natureza'
+  FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(p_itens) e;
+  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_n = ROW_COUNT;
+
+  SELECT COALESCE(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('ordem',d.ordem,'tipo_componente',d.tipo_componente,
+      'microrganismo_id',d.microrganismo_id,'componente_nome',d.componente_nome,'quantidade',d.quantidade,'unidade',d.unidade,
+      'base',d.base,'natureza',d.natureza) ORDER BY d.ordem), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_after
+    FROM public.produto_composicao_declaracoes d WHERE d.produto_id = p_produto_id;
+  IF v_after = v_before AND v_old_status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_status THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_composition_no_change'; END IF;
+
+  -- Versão monotônica do produto; demais colunas, receita e apresentações intactas.
+  UPDATE public.produtos SET updated_at = updated_at WHERE id = p_produto_id AND updated_at = p_expected_updated_at RETURNING * INTO v_np;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='catalog_composition_confirmation_failed'; END IF;
+  SELECT md5(COALESCE(string_agg(pg_catalog.to_jsonb(f)::text, ',' ORDER BY f.id), '')) INTO v_form_after FROM public.formulacoes f WHERE f.produto_id = p_produto_id;
+  SELECT md5(COALESCE(string_agg(pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v)::text, ',' ORDER BY v.id), '')) INTO v_vol_after FROM public.catalogo_volumes v WHERE v.produto_id = p_produto_id;
+  IF v_n <> pg_catalog.jsonb_array_length(p_itens) OR v_np.updated_at IS NULL OR v_np.updated_at <= v_op.updated_at
+     OR (pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_op) - 'updated_at') IS DISTINCT FROM (pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_np) - 'updated_at')
+     OR v_form_before IS DISTINCT FROM v_form_after OR v_vol_before IS DISTINCT FROM v_vol_after THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='catalog_composition_confirmation_failed'; END IF;
+
+  v_receipt := pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('produto_id',p_produto_id,'status',p_status,'itens',v_n,'updated_at',v_np.updated_at,
+    'idempotency_key',p_idempotency_key,'audit_id',v_audit,'idempotent',false);
+  PERFORM platform_private.catalog_entity_audit(v_actor,'set_global_product_composition',p_reason,p_idempotency_key,v_req,v_receipt,
+    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('produto_id',p_produto_id,'status',v_old_status,'itens',v_before,'updated_at',v_op.updated_at),
+    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('produto_id',p_produto_id,'status',p_status,'itens',v_after,'updated_at',v_np.updated_at));
+  RETURN v_receipt;
+END;
+$function$

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.set_global_product_family_core(p_id uuid, p_expected_updated_at timestamp with time zone, p_familia text, p_classe text, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE v_actor uuid; v_req jsonb; v_replay jsonb; v_receipt jsonb; v_audit uuid := gen_random_uuid();
+  v_op public.produtos%ROWTYPE; v_np public.produtos%ROWTYPE; v_old jsonb; v_new jsonb;
+  v_vols_before jsonb; v_vols_after jsonb; v_classe text := NULLIF(pg_catalog.btrim(COALESCE(p_classe,'')), '');
+BEGIN
+  v_actor := platform_private.catalog_metadata_require_actor();
+  IF p_id IS NULL OR p_expected_updated_at IS NULL OR NOT pg_catalog.isfinite(p_expected_updated_at) OR p_idempotency_key IS NULL
+     OR p_familia IS NULL OR p_familia NOT IN ('biologico','quimico','fertilizante_adubo') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_family_invalid';
+  END IF;
+  v_req := pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('id',p_id,'expected_updated_at',p_expected_updated_at,
+    'familia_catalogo',p_familia,'classe_catalogo',v_classe,'reason',pg_catalog.btrim(COALESCE(p_reason,'')));
+  v_replay := platform_private.catalog_entity_replay(v_actor,'set_global_product_family',v_req,p_reason,p_idempotency_key);
+  IF v_replay IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN v_replay; END IF;
+
+  -- Revalidação mutante APÓS o replay: só nova execução exige rótulo ativo (com lock).
+  IF NOT (v_classe IS NULL OR platform_private.catalog_family_label_check(p_familia, v_classe)) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_family_invalid';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_op FROM public.produtos WHERE id=p_id FOR UPDATE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501', MESSAGE='catalog_family_unavailable'; END IF;
+  IF v_op.updated_at IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_updated_at THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='catalog_family_conflict'; END IF;
+  IF v_op.familia_catalogo IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_familia AND v_op.classe_catalogo IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_classe THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_family_no_change'; END IF;
+  v_old := pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_op);
+  SELECT COALESCE(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.to_jsonb(cv) ORDER BY cv.id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_vols_before
+    FROM public.catalogo_volumes cv WHERE cv.produto_id=p_id;
+
+  UPDATE public.produtos SET familia_catalogo=p_familia, classe_catalogo=v_classe
+   WHERE id=p_id AND updated_at=p_expected_updated_at RETURNING * INTO v_np;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='catalog_family_confirmation_failed'; END IF;
+  v_new := pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_np);
+  SELECT COALESCE(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.to_jsonb(cv) ORDER BY cv.id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_vols_after
+    FROM public.catalogo_volumes cv WHERE cv.produto_id=p_id;
+  -- Somente família/classe/versão mudam (ativo, B2B, preços, dose, tipo, código, owner intactos).
+  IF v_np.familia_catalogo IS DISTINCT FROM p_familia OR v_np.classe_catalogo IS DISTINCT FROM v_classe
+     OR v_np.updated_at IS NULL OR v_np.updated_at <= v_op.updated_at
+     OR (v_old - ARRAY['familia_catalogo','classe_catalogo','updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM (v_new - ARRAY['familia_catalogo','classe_catalogo','updated_at'])
+     OR v_vols_before IS DISTINCT FROM v_vols_after THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='catalog_family_confirmation_failed'; END IF;
+
+  v_receipt := pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('id',p_id,'familia_catalogo',p_familia,'classe_catalogo',v_classe,
+    'updated_at',v_np.updated_at,'idempotency_key',p_idempotency_key,'audit_id',v_audit,'idempotent',false);
+  PERFORM platform_private.catalog_entity_audit(v_actor,'set_global_product_family',p_reason,p_idempotency_key,v_req,v_receipt,
+    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('id',p_id,'familia_catalogo',v_op.familia_catalogo,'classe_catalogo',v_op.classe_catalogo,'updated_at',v_op.updated_at),
+    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('id',p_id,'familia_catalogo',p_familia,'classe_catalogo',v_classe,'updated_at',v_np.updated_at));
+  RETURN v_receipt;
+END;
+$function$

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.set_global_product_status_core(p_id uuid, p_expected_updated_at timestamp with time zone, p_ativo boolean, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE v_actor uuid; v_old public.produtos%ROWTYPE; v_new public.produtos%ROWTYPE;
+  v_existing public.catalog_platform_admin_audit%ROWTYPE; v_request jsonb; v_receipt jsonb; v_audit uuid:=gen_random_uuid();
+BEGIN
+  v_actor:=platform_private.catalog_metadata_require_actor();
+  IF p_id IS NULL OR p_ativo IS NULL OR p_expected_updated_at IS NULL OR NOT pg_catalog.isfinite(p_expected_updated_at)
+    OR p_idempotency_key IS NULL OR p_reason IS NULL OR pg_catalog.char_length(pg_catalog.btrim(p_reason)) NOT BETWEEN 10 AND 500 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_status_invalid';
+  END IF;
+  v_request:=pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('id',p_id,'expected_updated_at',p_expected_updated_at,'ativo',p_ativo,'reason',pg_catalog.btrim(p_reason));
+  PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(pg_catalog.hashtextextended('catalog-metadata:'||p_idempotency_key::text,0));
+  SELECT * INTO v_old FROM public.produtos WHERE id=p_id FOR UPDATE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501', MESSAGE='catalog_status_unavailable'; END IF;
+  SELECT * INTO v_existing FROM public.catalog_platform_admin_audit WHERE correlation_id=p_idempotency_key;
+  IF FOUND THEN
+    IF v_existing.operation<>'set_global_product_status' OR v_existing.actor_id<>v_actor
+      OR v_existing.counts_after->'request' IS DISTINCT FROM v_request THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='catalog_status_conflict';
+    END IF;
+    RETURN (v_existing.counts_after->'receipt')||pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('idempotent',true);
+  END IF;
+  IF v_old.updated_at IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_updated_at THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='catalog_status_conflict'; END IF;
+  IF COALESCE(v_old.ativo,false)=p_ativo THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_status_no_change'; END IF;
+  -- Arquivar = ativo false. Nunca exclui; históricos (pedidos/estoque/fiscal) preservados.
+  -- b2b_enabled e preços não são tocados aqui.
+  UPDATE public.produtos SET ativo=p_ativo, updated_at=pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
+  WHERE id=p_id AND updated_at=p_expected_updated_at RETURNING * INTO v_new;
+  IF NOT FOUND OR v_new.id IS DISTINCT FROM p_id OR v_new.ativo IS DISTINCT FROM p_ativo
+    OR v_new.updated_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_old.updated_at OR v_new.updated_at <= v_old.updated_at
+    OR (pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_old)-ARRAY['ativo','updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM (pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_new)-ARRAY['ativo','updated_at']) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='catalog_status_confirmation_failed';
+  END IF;
+  v_receipt:=pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('id',p_id,'ativo',v_new.ativo,'updated_at',v_new.updated_at,
+    'idempotency_key',p_idempotency_key,'audit_id',v_audit,'idempotent',false);
+  INSERT INTO public.catalog_platform_admin_audit (id,operation,actor_id,reason,correlation_id,status,counts_before,counts_after,completed_at)
+  VALUES (v_audit,'set_global_product_status',v_actor,pg_catalog.btrim(p_reason),p_idempotency_key,'completed',
+    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('ativo',v_old.ativo),
+    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('request',v_request,'receipt',v_receipt,'after',pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('ativo',v_new.ativo)),
+    pg_catalog.clock_timestamp());
+  RETURN v_receipt;
+END;
+$function$

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.storage1_application_allowed(p_name text, p_action text)
+ RETURNS boolean
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE org uuid; r platform_private.application_save_preparations%ROWTYPE; a public.aplicacoes%ROWTYPE;
+ client uuid; os_org uuid; product uuid; staff boolean; u uuid:=auth.uid(); responsible uuid; own_role boolean; os_status text; lot uuid;
+BEGIN
+ IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR public.storage1_path_strict(p_name) IS DISTINCT FROM true OR p_action IS NULL
+ OR p_action NOT IN ('select','insert','update','delete') OR p_name !~ '^[0-9a-f-]{36}/[0-9a-f-]{36}/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$' THEN RETURN false; END IF;
+ org:=public.h15_actor_organization(); IF org IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
+ SELECT * INTO r FROM platform_private.application_save_preparations WHERE application_id=split_part(p_name,'/',2)::uuid;
+ IF p_action='insert' AND r.application_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+ IF r.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid() OR r.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM org OR r.committed_at IS NOT NULL
+ OR r.expires_at<=clock_timestamp() OR r.client_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM split_part(p_name,'/',1)
+ OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.manifest) ev WHERE ev->>'storage_path'=p_name)
+ OR public.can_user_create_aplicacao_for_cliente(r.client_id) IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN RETURN false; END IF;
+ -- Exact current RPC membership branch: a broad operator/applicator role must
+ -- not rescue a revoked consultant/technical/producer portfolio.
+ IF (public.has_role(u,'cliente_produtor') OR public.has_role(u,'consultor_tecnico') OR public.has_role(u,'tecnico_agronomo'))
+ AND NOT (public.has_role(u,'administrador') OR public.has_role(u,'gestor') OR public.has_role(u,'administrativo'))
+ AND NOT r.client_id=ANY(public.get_cliente_ids_for_user(u)) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
+ responsible:=nullif(r.payload->>'responsavel_id','')::uuid;
+ IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id=responsible AND organization_id=org AND ativo IS TRUE AND senha_provisoria IS FALSE)
+ OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=responsible AND role::text IN
+ ('administrador','gestor','administrativo','consultor_tecnico','tecnico_agronomo','aplicador','operador_onfarm','cliente_produtor'))
+ OR platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(responsible) IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN RETURN false; END IF;
+ own_role:=public.has_role(u,'administrador') OR public.has_role(u,'gestor') OR public.has_role(u,'administrativo') OR public.has_role(u,'consultor_tecnico');
+ IF NOT own_role AND responsible IS DISTINCT FROM u THEN RETURN false; END IF;
+ lot:=nullif(r.payload->>'lote_usado_id','')::uuid;
+ IF r.payload->>'ordem_servico_id' IS NOT NULL THEN
+ SELECT cliente_id,organization_id,produto_id,status::text INTO client,os_org,product,os_status FROM public.ordens_servico WHERE id=(r.payload->>'ordem_servico_id')::uuid;
+ ELSE SELECT os.cliente_id,c.organization_id,os.produto_id,os.status::text INTO client,os_org,product,os_status FROM public.ordens_servico_onfarm os JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=os.cliente_id WHERE os.id=(r.payload->>'ordem_servico_onfarm_id')::uuid; END IF;
+ RETURN client=r.client_id AND os_org=org AND product::text=r.payload->>'produto_usado_id'
+ AND (os_status IN ('entregue','pronto_entrega','envase') OR (r.rectify_id IS NOT NULL AND os_status='finalizada'))
+ AND (lot IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.lotes WHERE id=lot AND produto_id=product AND organization_id=org AND status='aprovado'))
+ AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.clientes WHERE id=client AND organization_id=org)
+ AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos WHERE id=product AND ativo IS TRUE)
+ AND (r.rectify_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.aplicacoes WHERE id=r.rectify_id AND organization_id=org AND is_latest IS TRUE)
+ AND public.can_user_manage_aplicacao(r.rectify_id) AND public.can_user_access_aplicacao(r.rectify_id))
+ AND public.h15_actor_organization()=org;
+ END IF;
+ SELECT * INTO a FROM public.aplicacoes WHERE id=split_part(p_name,'/',2)::uuid;
+ IF NOT FOUND OR a.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM org OR (a.ordem_servico_id IS NULL)=(a.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NULL) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
+ IF a.ordem_servico_id IS NOT NULL THEN SELECT cliente_id,organization_id INTO client,os_org FROM public.ordens_servico WHERE id=a.ordem_servico_id;
+ ELSE SELECT os.cliente_id,c.organization_id INTO client,os_org FROM public.ordens_servico_onfarm os JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=os.cliente_id WHERE os.id=a.ordem_servico_onfarm_id; END IF;
+ IF client::text IS DISTINCT FROM split_part(p_name,'/',1) OR os_org IS DISTINCT FROM org
+ OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.clientes WHERE id=client AND organization_id=org) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
+ staff:=NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(),'aplicador') OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador') OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'gestor')
+ OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrativo') OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'consultor_tecnico') OR a.responsavel_id=auth.uid()
+ OR client=ANY(public.get_cliente_ids_for_user(auth.uid()));
+ IF p_action='select' THEN RETURN staff AND public.can_user_access_aplicacao(a.id); END IF;
+ -- Finalized objects are immutable. Deletion remains denied when metadata references bytes.
+ IF p_action IN ('insert','update') THEN RETURN false; END IF;
+ RETURN staff AND a.is_latest IS TRUE AND public.can_user_manage_aplicacao(a.id)
+ AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.aplicacao_evidencias WHERE storage_path=p_name);
+EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN RETURN false;
+END;
+$function$

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.update_global_microorganism_core(p_id uuid, p_expected_updated_at timestamp with time zone, p_patch jsonb, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE v_actor uuid; v jsonb; v_req jsonb; v_replay jsonb; v_old public.microrganismos%ROWTYPE; v_new public.microrganismos%ROWTYPE;
+  v_before jsonb; v_after jsonb; v_receipt jsonb; v_keys text[];
+BEGIN
+  v_actor:=platform_private.catalog_metadata_require_actor();
+  IF p_id IS NULL OR p_expected_updated_at IS NULL OR NOT pg_catalog.isfinite(p_expected_updated_at) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_entity_invalid'; END IF;
+  v:=platform_private.catalog_micro_normalize(p_patch,false);
+  v_req:=pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('id',p_id,'expected_updated_at',p_expected_updated_at,'patch',v,'reason',pg_catalog.btrim(p_reason));
+  v_replay:=platform_private.catalog_entity_replay(v_actor,'update_global_microorganism',v_req,p_reason,p_idempotency_key);
+  IF v_replay IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN v_replay; END IF;
+  SELECT * INTO v_old FROM public.microrganismos WHERE id=p_id FOR UPDATE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501', MESSAGE='catalog_entity_unavailable'; END IF;
+  IF v_old.updated_at IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_updated_at THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='catalog_entity_conflict'; END IF;
+  v_before:=platform_private.read_global_microorganism_detail_core(p_id);
+  SELECT pg_catalog.array_agg(k) INTO v_keys FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_object_keys(v) k;
+  BEGIN
+    UPDATE public.microrganismos SET
+      nome=CASE WHEN v ? 'nome' THEN v->>'nome' ELSE nome END,
+      nome_cientifico=CASE WHEN v ? 'nome_cientifico' THEN v->>'nome_cientifico' ELSE nome_cientifico END,
+      concentracao_ufc_ml=CASE WHEN v ? 'concentracao_ufc_ml' THEN (v->>'concentracao_ufc_ml')::numeric ELSE concentracao_ufc_ml END,
+      concentracao_label=CASE WHEN v ? 'concentracao_label' THEN v->>'concentracao_label' ELSE concentracao_label END,
+      fornecedor=CASE WHEN v ? 'fornecedor' THEN v->>'fornecedor' ELSE fornecedor END,
+      producao_on_farm=CASE WHEN v ? 'producao_on_farm' THEN (v->>'producao_on_farm')::boolean ELSE producao_on_farm END,
+      meio_cultivo=CASE WHEN v ? 'meio_cultivo' THEN v->>'meio_cultivo' ELSE meio_cultivo END,
+      funcao_agronomica=CASE WHEN v ? 'funcao_agronomica' THEN v->>'funcao_agronomica' ELSE funcao_agronomica END,
+      observacoes=CASE WHEN v ? 'observacoes' THEN v->>'observacoes' ELSE observacoes END,
+      descricao=CASE WHEN v ? 'descricao' THEN v->>'descricao' ELSE descricao END
+    WHERE id=p_id AND updated_at=p_expected_updated_at RETURNING * INTO v_new;
+  EXCEPTION WHEN unique_violation THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23505', MESSAGE='catalog_entity_duplicate';
+  END;
+  -- Confirma linha/ID/versão e que NENHUMA coluna fora da whitelist mudou — inclusive preços (valor_dose_brl,
+  -- valor_litro_brl, preco_tabela), dose, B2B, código, produto e ativo. Se algum trigger (ex.: guard de preço
+  -- canônico) recalcular campo protegido, a edição descritiva aborta integralmente (rollback da transação).
+  IF NOT FOUND OR v_new.id IS DISTINCT FROM p_id OR v_new.updated_at <= v_old.updated_at
+    OR (pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_old) - v_keys - 'updated_at')
+       IS DISTINCT FROM (pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_new) - v_keys - 'updated_at') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='catalog_entity_confirmation_failed'; END IF;
+  v_after:=platform_private.read_global_microorganism_detail_core(p_id);
+  v_receipt:=pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('id',p_id,'ativo',v_new.ativo,'updated_at',v_new.updated_at,
+    'idempotency_key',p_idempotency_key,'audit_id',gen_random_uuid(),'idempotent',false);
+  PERFORM platform_private.catalog_entity_audit(v_actor,'update_global_microorganism',p_reason,p_idempotency_key,v_req,v_receipt,v_before,v_after);
+  RETURN v_receipt;
+END;
+$function$

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.update_global_product_metadata_core(p_id uuid, p_expected_updated_at timestamp with time zone, p_patch jsonb, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_actor uuid; v_old public.produtos%ROWTYPE; v_new public.produtos%ROWTYPE;
+  v_existing public.catalog_platform_admin_audit%ROWTYPE;
+  v_patch jsonb:='{}'::jsonb; v_before jsonb:='{}'::jsonb; v_after jsonb:='{}'::jsonb;
+  v_request jsonb; v_receipt jsonb; v_audit uuid; v_field text; v_text text;
+  v_fields constant text[]:=ARRAY['nome','descricao','modo_acao','funcao_completa','modo_aplicacao'];
+BEGIN
+  -- Direct core calls have EXACTLY the wrapper's authorization/validation; no
+  -- caller/GUC ticket can bypass these checks. service_role without actor denied.
+  v_actor:=platform_private.catalog_metadata_require_actor();
+  IF p_id IS NULL OR p_expected_updated_at IS NULL OR NOT pg_catalog.isfinite(p_expected_updated_at)
+    OR p_idempotency_key IS NULL OR p_reason IS NULL OR pg_catalog.char_length(pg_catalog.btrim(p_reason)) NOT BETWEEN 10 AND 500
+    OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(p_patch) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR p_patch='{}'::jsonb THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_metadata_invalid';
+  END IF;
+  FOR v_field IN SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_object_keys(p_patch) LOOP
+    IF NOT (v_field=ANY(v_fields)) OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(p_patch->v_field) NOT IN ('string','null') THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_metadata_invalid';
+    END IF;
+    v_text:=p_patch->>v_field;
+    IF v_field='nome' THEN
+      IF v_text IS NULL OR pg_catalog.char_length(pg_catalog.btrim(v_text)) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 500 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_metadata_invalid';
+      END IF;
+      v_text:=pg_catalog.btrim(v_text);
+    ELSIF pg_catalog.char_length(v_text)>10000 THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_metadata_invalid';
+    END IF;
+    v_patch:=v_patch || pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(v_field,v_text);
+  END LOOP;
+  -- Serialize globally unique correlation BEFORE product lock. Same key on
+  -- different actor/target cannot expose a replay; comparison happens after auth.
+  PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(pg_catalog.hashtextextended('catalog-metadata:'||p_idempotency_key::text,0));
+  SELECT * INTO v_old FROM public.produtos WHERE id=p_id FOR UPDATE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501', MESSAGE='catalog_metadata_unavailable'; END IF;
+  v_request:=pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('id',p_id,'expected_updated_at',p_expected_updated_at,
+    'patch',v_patch,'reason',pg_catalog.btrim(p_reason));
+  SELECT * INTO v_existing FROM public.catalog_platform_admin_audit WHERE correlation_id=p_idempotency_key;
+  IF FOUND THEN
+    IF v_existing.operation<>'update_global_product_metadata' OR v_existing.actor_id<>v_actor
+      OR v_existing.counts_after->'request' IS DISTINCT FROM v_request THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='catalog_metadata_conflict';
+    END IF;
+    RETURN (v_existing.counts_after->'receipt') || pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('idempotent',true);
+  END IF;
+  IF v_old.updated_at IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_updated_at THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='catalog_metadata_conflict';
+  END IF;
+  FOR v_field IN SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_object_keys(v_patch) LOOP
+    IF pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_old)->v_field IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_patch->v_field THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_metadata_no_change';
+    END IF;
+    v_before:=v_before || pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(v_field,pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_old)->v_field);
+  END LOOP;
+  UPDATE public.produtos SET
+    nome=CASE WHEN v_patch?'nome' THEN v_patch->>'nome' ELSE nome END,
+    descricao=CASE WHEN v_patch?'descricao' THEN v_patch->>'descricao' ELSE descricao END,
+    modo_acao=CASE WHEN v_patch?'modo_acao' THEN v_patch->>'modo_acao' ELSE modo_acao END,
+    funcao_completa=CASE WHEN v_patch?'funcao_completa' THEN v_patch->>'funcao_completa' ELSE funcao_completa END,
+    modo_aplicacao=CASE WHEN v_patch?'modo_aplicacao' THEN v_patch->>'modo_aplicacao' ELSE modo_aplicacao END,
+    updated_at=pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
+  WHERE id=p_id AND updated_at=p_expected_updated_at RETURNING * INTO v_new;
+  IF NOT FOUND OR v_new.id IS DISTINCT FROM p_id OR v_new.updated_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_old.updated_at
+    OR (pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_old)-(v_fields||ARRAY['updated_at'])) IS DISTINCT FROM
+       (pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_new)-(v_fields||ARRAY['updated_at'])) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='catalog_metadata_confirmation_failed';
+  END IF;
+  FOR v_field IN SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_object_keys(v_patch) LOOP
+    IF pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_new)->v_field IS DISTINCT FROM v_patch->v_field THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='catalog_metadata_confirmation_failed';
+    END IF;
+    v_after:=v_after || pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(v_field,pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_new)->v_field);
+  END LOOP;
+  FOREACH v_field IN ARRAY v_fields LOOP
+    IF NOT (v_patch?v_field) AND pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_old)->v_field IS DISTINCT FROM pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_new)->v_field THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='catalog_metadata_confirmation_failed';
+    END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  v_audit:=pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid();
+  v_receipt:=pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('id',p_id,'updated_at',v_new.updated_at,
+    'idempotency_key',p_idempotency_key,'idempotent',false,'audit_id',v_audit);
+  INSERT INTO public.catalog_platform_admin_audit(id,operation,actor_id,reason,correlation_id,status,counts_before,counts_after,completed_at)
+  VALUES(v_audit,'update_global_product_metadata',v_actor,pg_catalog.btrim(p_reason),p_idempotency_key,'completed',
+    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('values',v_before),pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('values',v_after,'request',v_request,'receipt',v_receipt),pg_catalog.clock_timestamp());
+  RETURN v_receipt;
+END;
+$function$

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._entrega_seed_checklist(_entrega_id uuid)

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.approve_microorganism_profile_with_audit(p_profile_id uuid, p_checklist jsonb, p_aprovado_sem_fonte boolean DEFAULT false)
+ RETURNS void
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_micro_id uuid;
+  v_b2b_enabled boolean := false;
+  v_has_sources boolean := false;
+BEGIN
+  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'auth_required';
+  END IF;
+  IF NOT (
+    has_role(v_uid, 'administrador'::app_role)
+    OR has_role(v_uid, 'gestor'::app_role)
+    OR has_role(v_uid, 'consultor_tecnico'::app_role)
+    OR has_role(v_uid, 'tecnico_agronomo'::app_role)
+  ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT microrganismo_id INTO v_micro_id FROM microorganism_technical_profiles WHERE id = p_profile_id;
+  IF v_micro_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'profile_not_found';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT COALESCE(b2b_enabled, false) INTO v_b2b_enabled FROM microrganismos WHERE id = v_micro_id;
+
+  SELECT EXISTS(
+    SELECT 1 FROM catalog_technical_sources
+    WHERE (entidade_tipo = 'microrganismo' AND entidade_id = v_micro_id)
+       OR (entidade_tipo = 'ficha_microrganismo' AND entidade_id = p_profile_id)
+  ) INTO v_has_sources;
+
+  PERFORM public.validate_catalog_approval_checklist('micro', p_checklist, v_b2b_enabled, v_has_sources, p_aprovado_sem_fonte);
+
+  UPDATE microorganism_technical_profiles
+  SET status_validacao = 'aprovado',
+      validado_por = v_uid,
+      validado_em = now(),
+      updated_by = v_uid,
+      updated_at = now()
+  WHERE id = p_profile_id;
+
+  INSERT INTO catalog_technical_audit_logs (entidade_tipo, entidade_id, acao, usuario_id, dados_novos)
+  VALUES (
+    'ficha_microrganismo',
+    p_profile_id,
+    CASE WHEN p_aprovado_sem_fonte THEN 'aprovacao_tecnica_sem_fonte' ELSE 'aprovacao_tecnica' END,
+    v_uid,
+    jsonb_build_object(
+      'checklist_aprovacao', p_checklist,
+      'aprovado_por', v_uid,
+      'aprovado_em', now(),
+      'aprovado_sem_fonte', p_aprovado_sem_fonte
+    )
+  );
+END;
+$function$

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_b2b_resolve_base_unit_price(p_partner_id uuid, p_product_id uuid, p_microrganismo_id uuid, p_unit_type text, p_volume_ml numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric, p_ref_date date DEFAULT NULL::date)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_ref  date := COALESCE(p_ref_date, current_date);
+  v_base numeric(18,6);
+  v_src  text;
+BEGIN
+  IF num_nonnulls(p_product_id, p_microrganismo_id) <> 1 THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'reason_code', 'ITEM_INVALID');
+  END IF;
+  IF p_unit_type IS NULL OR p_unit_type NOT IN ('hectare','litro','dose','unidade') THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'reason_code', 'UNIT_INVALID');
+  END IF;
+  IF p_unit_type = 'unidade' AND COALESCE(p_volume_ml, 0) <= 0 THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'reason_code', 'VOLUME_REQUIRED');
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_partner_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT ppp.preco_tabela INTO v_base
+    FROM public.partner_product_prices ppp
+    WHERE ppp.partner_id = p_partner_id
+      AND ppp.ativo
+      AND ppp.product_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_product_id
+      AND ppp.microrganismo_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_microrganismo_id
+      AND (ppp.valid_from IS NULL OR ppp.valid_from <= v_ref)
+      AND (ppp.valid_until IS NULL OR ppp.valid_until >= v_ref)
+    ORDER BY ppp.is_current DESC, ppp.valid_from DESC NULLS LAST
+    LIMIT 1;
+    IF COALESCE(v_base, 0) > 0 THEN v_src := 'partner_base_price'; ELSE v_base := NULL; END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- H3b: fonte canonica de preco comercial = catalogo_volumes (apresentacao ativa).
+  IF v_base IS NULL THEN
+    v_base := public.fn_catalogo_preco_canonico(p_product_id, p_microrganismo_id, p_unit_type, p_volume_ml);
+    IF COALESCE(v_base,0) > 0 THEN v_src := 'catalog_volume_price'; ELSE v_base := NULL; END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Fallback legado documentado: mestre produtos/microrganismos (nao canonico).
+  IF v_base IS NULL THEN
+    IF p_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+      SELECT CASE p_unit_type
+               WHEN 'hectare' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(pr.valor_ha_brl,0), (pr.dose_ml_ha/100.0) * pr.valor_dose_brl)
+               WHEN 'litro'   THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(pr.valor_litro_brl,0), pr.valor_dose_brl * 10)
+               WHEN 'dose'    THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(pr.valor_dose_brl,0), pr.valor_litro_brl / 10)
+               WHEN 'unidade' THEN (p_volume_ml / 1000.0) * COALESCE(NULLIF(pr.valor_litro_brl,0), pr.valor_dose_brl*10)
+             END
+        INTO v_base
+      FROM public.produtos pr WHERE pr.id = p_product_id;
+    ELSE
+      SELECT CASE p_unit_type
+               WHEN 'hectare' THEN (mo.dose_ml_ha/100.0) * mo.valor_dose_brl
+               WHEN 'litro'   THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(mo.valor_litro_brl,0), mo.valor_dose_brl * 10)
+               WHEN 'dose'    THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(mo.valor_dose_brl,0), mo.valor_litro_brl / 10)
+               WHEN 'unidade' THEN (p_volume_ml / 1000.0) * COALESCE(NULLIF(mo.valor_litro_brl,0), mo.valor_dose_brl*10)
+             END
+        INTO v_base
+      FROM public.microrganismos mo WHERE mo.id = p_microrganismo_id;
+    END IF;
+    IF COALESCE(v_base, 0) > 0 THEN v_src := 'catalog_base_price'; ELSE v_base := NULL; END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_base IS NULL OR v_base <= 0 THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'reason_code', 'ITEM_WITHOUT_PRICE');
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+    'ok', true, 'reason_code', 'OK',
+    'price_source', v_src,
+    'base_price', round(v_base, 2),
+    'currency', 'BRL',
+    'resolved_at', now()
+  );
+END
+$function$

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_catalogo_litro_canonico(p_produto_id uuid, p_microrganismo_id uuid, OUT litro numeric, OUT tiers integer)

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_catalogo_preco_canonico(p_product_id uuid, p_microrganismo_id uuid, p_unit_type text, p_volume_ml numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric)
+ RETURNS numeric
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_litro   numeric(18,6);
+  v_distint integer;
+  v_dose_ha numeric;
+  v_unit    numeric(18,6);
+BEGIN
+  IF num_nonnulls(p_product_id, p_microrganismo_id) <> 1 THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
+  IF p_unit_type IS NULL OR p_unit_type NOT IN ('hectare','litro','dose','unidade') THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
+
+  SELECT count(DISTINCT round(cv.preco_litro_brl,2)), min(round(cv.preco_litro_brl,2))
+    INTO v_distint, v_litro
+  FROM public.catalogo_volumes cv
+  WHERE cv.ativo = true
+    AND cv.preco_litro_brl IS NOT NULL
+    AND cv.produto_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_product_id
+    AND cv.microrganismo_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_microrganismo_id;
+
+  IF COALESCE(v_distint,0) <> 1 OR COALESCE(v_litro,0) <= 0 THEN
+    RETURN NULL;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_unit_type = 'unidade' THEN
+    IF COALESCE(p_volume_ml,0) <= 0 THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
+    SELECT round(cv.preco_brl,2) INTO v_unit
+    FROM public.catalogo_volumes cv
+    WHERE cv.ativo = true
+      AND cv.volume_ml = p_volume_ml
+      AND cv.produto_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_product_id
+      AND cv.microrganismo_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_microrganismo_id
+    ORDER BY cv.volume_ml
+    LIMIT 1;
+    RETURN COALESCE(v_unit, round(v_litro * (p_volume_ml / 1000.0), 2));
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_unit_type = 'litro' THEN RETURN v_litro; END IF;
+  IF p_unit_type = 'dose'  THEN RETURN round(v_litro / 10.0, 2); END IF;
+
+  -- hectare
+  IF p_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT pr.dose_ml_ha INTO v_dose_ha FROM public.produtos pr WHERE pr.id = p_product_id;
+  ELSE
+    SELECT mo.dose_ml_ha INTO v_dose_ha FROM public.microrganismos mo WHERE mo.id = p_microrganismo_id;
+  END IF;
+  IF COALESCE(v_dose_ha,0) <= 0 THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
+  RETURN round(v_litro * (v_dose_ha / 1000.0), 2);
+END
+$function$

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_catalogo_sync_mestre_preco(p_produto_id uuid, p_microrganismo_id uuid)
+ RETURNS void
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_litro numeric;
+  v_tiers integer;
+BEGIN
+  IF num_nonnulls(p_produto_id, p_microrganismo_id) <> 1 THEN RETURN; END IF;
+
+  SELECT litro, tiers INTO v_litro, v_tiers
+  FROM public.fn_catalogo_litro_canonico(p_produto_id, p_microrganismo_id);
+
+  IF COALESCE(v_tiers,0) = 0 THEN
+    RETURN; -- sem apresentacao ativa: preserva fallback legado
+  END IF;
+
+  PERFORM set_config('arbio.catalogo_sync', 'on', true);
+
+  IF p_produto_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    IF v_tiers = 1 AND COALESCE(v_litro,0) > 0 THEN
+      UPDATE public.produtos p
+         SET valor_litro_brl = v_litro,
+             valor_dose_brl  = round(v_litro / 10.0, 2),
+             valor_ha_brl    = CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.dose_ml_ha,0) > 0
+                                    THEN round(v_litro * (p.dose_ml_ha / 1000.0), 2) END
+       WHERE p.id = p_produto_id
+         AND (p.valor_litro_brl IS DISTINCT FROM v_litro
+              OR p.valor_dose_brl IS DISTINCT FROM round(v_litro / 10.0, 2));
+    ELSE
+      UPDATE public.produtos p
+         SET valor_litro_brl = NULL, valor_dose_brl = NULL, valor_ha_brl = NULL
+       WHERE p.id = p_produto_id
+         AND (p.valor_litro_brl IS NOT NULL OR p.valor_dose_brl IS NOT NULL OR p.valor_ha_brl IS NOT NULL);
+    END IF;
+  ELSE
+    IF v_tiers = 1 AND COALESCE(v_litro,0) > 0 THEN
+      UPDATE public.microrganismos m
+         SET valor_litro_brl = v_litro,
+             valor_dose_brl  = round(v_litro / 10.0, 2)
+       WHERE m.id = p_microrganismo_id
+         AND (m.valor_litro_brl IS DISTINCT FROM v_litro
+              OR m.valor_dose_brl IS DISTINCT FROM round(v_litro / 10.0, 2));
+    ELSE
+      UPDATE public.microrganismos m
+         SET valor_litro_brl = NULL, valor_dose_brl = NULL
+       WHERE m.id = p_microrganismo_id
+         AND (m.valor_litro_brl IS NOT NULL OR m.valor_dose_brl IS NOT NULL);
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  PERFORM set_config('arbio.catalogo_sync', 'off', true);
+END
+$function$

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_comprovante_entrega_montar_v1(p_entrega_id uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  e            public.entregas%ROWTYPE;
+  v_emitente   jsonb;
+  v_destino    jsonb;
+  v_os         jsonb;
+  v_itens      jsonb;
+  v_transporte jsonb;
+  v_receb      jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  PERFORM public.h15_require_staff();
+
+  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPROVANTE_UNAUTHENTICATED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF NOT coalesce(public.is_delivery_staff(auth.uid()),false) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPROVANTE_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  SELECT * INTO e FROM public.entregas WHERE id = p_entrega_id;
+  IF e.id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPROVANTE_ENTREGA_NAO_ENCONTRADA';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+           'razao_social', cs.legal_name,
+           'nome_fantasia', cs.trade_name,
+           'cnpj', cs.cnpj,
+           'inscricao_estadual', cs.state_registration,
+           'email', cs.fiscal_email,
+           'telefone', cs.phone,
+           'logradouro', cs.street,
+           'numero', cs.number,
+           'complemento', cs.complement,
+           'bairro', cs.neighborhood,
+           'cidade', cs.city,
+           'uf', cs.state,
+           'cep', cs.postal_code
+         )
+    INTO v_emitente
+    FROM (SELECT * FROM public.company_fiscal_settings WHERE organization_id = public.h15_actor_organization()) cs
+   WHERE cs.is_active
+   ORDER BY cs.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
+   LIMIT 1;
+
+  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+           'cliente_id', c.id,
+           'nome', coalesce(nullif(btrim(c.razao_social), ''), c.nome),
+           'nome_fantasia', c.nome_fantasia,
+           'cpf_cnpj', c.cpf_cnpj,
+           'telefone', coalesce(nullif(btrim(c.telefone), ''), e.destinatario_telefone),
+           'email', c.email,
+           'cidade', coalesce(nullif(btrim(e.endereco_cidade), ''), c.endereco_municipio),
+           'uf', coalesce(nullif(btrim(e.endereco_uf), ''), c.endereco_estado)
+         )
+    INTO v_destino
+    FROM public.clientes c
+   WHERE c.id = e.cliente_id;
+
+  v_destino := coalesce(v_destino, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
+    'destinatario_nome', e.destinatario_nome,
+    'local_entrega', nullif(btrim(concat_ws(', ',
+        nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.endereco_logradouro, '')), ''),
+        nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.endereco_numero, '')), ''),
+        nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.endereco_bairro, '')), ''),
+        nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.endereco_cidade, '')), ''),
+        nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.endereco_uf, '')), ''))), '')
+  );
+
+  -- OS canonica: fluxo padrao (ordens_servico) ou fluxo On-Farm legitimo.
+  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+           'os_id', o.id,
+           'numero_os', o.numero_os,
+           'origem', coalesce(o.origem, 'manual'),
+           'tipo', 'ordem_servico'
+         )
+    INTO v_os
+    FROM public.ordens_servico o
+   WHERE o.id = e.ordem_servico_id;
+
+  IF v_os IS NULL AND e.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+             'os_id', onf.id,
+             'numero_os', onf.numero_os,
+             'origem', 'on_farm',
+             'tipo', 'ordem_servico_onfarm'
+           )
+      INTO v_os
+      FROM public.ordens_servico_onfarm onf
+     WHERE onf.id = e.ordem_servico_onfarm_id;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Origem legitima adicional mapeada no dominio: entrega vinculada a pedido
+  -- de parceiro (B2B) sem OS de laboratorio. Documentado em
+  -- docs/auditorias/comprovante-entrega-fase2.md.
+  IF v_os IS NULL AND e.partner_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+             'os_id', po.id,
+             'numero_os', po.numero,
+             'origem', 'pedido_parceiro',
+             'tipo', 'partner_order'
+           )
+      INTO v_os
+      FROM public.partner_orders po
+     WHERE po.id = e.partner_order_id;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Itens: caminho canonico por etiqueta
+  SELECT jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY item->>'lote')
+    INTO v_itens
+    FROM (
+      SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+               'produto', coalesce(pe.produto_nome, pr.nome),
+               'microrganismo', coalesce(array_to_string(pe.cepas, ', '), m.nome_cientifico, m.nome),
+               'lote', coalesce(pe.lote_codigo, l.codigo_lote),
+               'fabricacao', coalesce(pe.fabricado_em::date, l.data_producao),
+               'validade', pe.validade_em::date,
+               'embalagem', coalesce(eb.tipo_embalagem, pe.unidade),
+               'quantidade', coalesce(pe.quantidade_embalagens, 1),
+               'volume_unitario_ml', pe.volume,
+               'volume_total_ml', coalesce(pe.volume, 0) * coalesce(pe.quantidade_embalagens, 1)
+             ) AS item
+        FROM public.entrega_etiquetas ee
+        JOIN public.produto_etiquetas pe ON pe.id = ee.etiqueta_id
+        LEFT JOIN public.produtos pr ON pr.id = pe.produto_id
+        LEFT JOIN public.lotes l ON l.id = pe.lote_id
+        LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = l.microrganismo_id
+        LEFT JOIN public.estoque_embalagens eb ON eb.id = pe.embalagem_id
+       WHERE ee.entrega_id = p_entrega_id AND ee.ativo
+    ) s;
+
+  -- Fallback: vinculo direto da entrega (fluxo classico produto_id/lote_id).
+  -- Referencias sempre por e2 (linha atual), sem depender da variavel PL/pgSQL.
+  IF v_itens IS NULL OR jsonb_array_length(v_itens) = 0 THEN
+    SELECT jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+             'produto', pr.nome,
+             'microrganismo', coalesce(m.nome_cientifico, m.nome),
+             'lote', l.codigo_lote,
+             'fabricacao', l.data_producao,
+             'validade', ep.validade,
+             'embalagem', env.tipo_embalagem,
+             'quantidade', e2.quantidade_entregue,
+             'volume_unitario_ml', coalesce(
+               env.volume_por_unidade,
+               CASE WHEN coalesce(e2.quantidade_entregue, 0) > 0
+                    THEN round(e2.volume_entregue_ml / e2.quantidade_entregue, 2) END),
+             'volume_total_ml', coalesce(
+               e2.volume_entregue_ml,
+               env.volume_por_unidade * e2.quantidade_entregue)
+           ))
+      INTO v_itens
+      FROM public.entregas e2
+      LEFT JOIN public.produtos pr
+             ON pr.id = coalesce(e2.produto_id,
+                                 (SELECT l2.produto_id FROM public.lotes l2 WHERE l2.id = e2.lote_id))
+      LEFT JOIN public.lotes l ON l.id = e2.lote_id
+      LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = l.microrganismo_id
+      LEFT JOIN public.estoque_produto ep ON ep.id = e2.estoque_produto_id
+      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
+        SELECT en.tipo_embalagem, en.volume_por_unidade
+          FROM public.envase en
+         WHERE en.lote_id = e2.lote_id
+         ORDER BY en.data_envase DESC NULLS LAST
+         LIMIT 1
+      ) env ON true
+     WHERE e2.id = p_entrega_id;
+  END IF;
+
+  v_transporte := jsonb_build_object(
+    'modalidade', e.tipo_entrega,
+    'motorista', e.motorista,
+    'motorista_telefone', e.motorista_telefone,
+    'veiculo', e.veiculo,
+    'placa', e.veiculo_placa,
+    'veiculo_tipo', e.veiculo_tipo,
+    'data_saida', e.data_saida,
+    'hora_saida_prevista', e.hora_saida_prevista
+  );
+
+  v_receb := jsonb_build_object(
+    'recebido_por_nome', coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.recebido_por_nome, '')), ''),
+                                  nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.recebedor_nome, '')), '')),
+    'documento', coalesce(e.recebido_por_documento, e.recebedor_documento),
+    'cargo', coalesce(e.recebido_por_cargo, e.recebedor_cargo),
+    'observacoes', e.observacoes_confirmacao,
+    'confirmado_em', coalesce(e.confirmada_em, e.entregue_em, e.recebimento_confirmado_em),
+    'confirmado_por', coalesce(e.confirmado_por, e.confirmada_por, e.recebimento_confirmado_por),
+    'assinatura_tipo', e.assinatura_tipo
+  );
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+    'template_versao', 'comprovante-entrega-v1',
+    'entrega_id', e.id,
+    'entrega_status', e.status::text,
+    'emitente', coalesce(v_emitente, '{}'::jsonb),
+    'destinatario', coalesce(v_destino, '{}'::jsonb),
+    'ordem_servico', v_os,
+    'itens', coalesce(v_itens, '[]'::jsonb),
+    'transporte', v_transporte,
+    'recebimento', v_receb
+  );
+END
+$function$

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_entrega_build_snapshot_v1(p_entrega_id uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'sessao_invalida' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF NOT coalesce(public.is_delivery_staff(auth.uid()), false) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'sem_permissao' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  SELECT jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
+    'template_versao', 'termo-entrega-v1',
+    'gerado_em', now(),
+    'entrega', to_jsonb(e),
+    'cliente', (SELECT to_jsonb(c) FROM public.clientes c WHERE c.id = e.cliente_id),
+    'ordem_servico', (SELECT to_jsonb(o) FROM public.ordens_servico o WHERE o.id = e.ordem_servico_id),
+    'ordem_servico_onfarm', (SELECT to_jsonb(o) FROM public.ordens_servico_onfarm o WHERE o.id = e.ordem_servico_onfarm_id),
+    'pedido_b2b', (SELECT to_jsonb(po) FROM public.partner_orders po WHERE po.id = e.partner_order_id),
+    'comprovante', (SELECT to_jsonb(cp) FROM public.entrega_comprovantes cp WHERE cp.id = e.comprovante_id),
+    'entregador', jsonb_build_object(
+      'motorista', e.motorista, 'documento', e.motorista_documento,
+      'telefone', e.motorista_telefone, 'veiculo', e.veiculo,
+      'placa', e.veiculo_placa, 'tipo', e.veiculo_tipo),
+    'destino', jsonb_build_object(
+      'destinatario', e.destinatario_nome, 'telefone', e.destinatario_telefone,
+      'logradouro', e.endereco_logradouro, 'numero', e.endereco_numero,
+      'complemento', e.endereco_complemento, 'bairro', e.endereco_bairro,
+      'cidade', e.endereco_cidade, 'uf', e.endereco_uf, 'cep', e.endereco_cep,
+      'referencia', e.endereco_referencia, 'origem', e.endereco_origem),
+    'recebedor', jsonb_build_object(
+      'nome', e.recebedor_nome, 'documento', e.recebedor_documento,
+      'cargo', e.recebedor_cargo, 'telefone', e.recebedor_telefone),
+    'itens', coalesce((
+      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
+        'etiqueta', to_jsonb(pe),
+        'embalagem', (SELECT to_jsonb(eb) FROM public.estoque_embalagens eb WHERE eb.id = pe.embalagem_id),
+        'lote', (SELECT to_jsonb(l) FROM public.lotes l WHERE l.id = pe.lote_id),
+        'produto', (SELECT to_jsonb(pr) FROM public.produtos pr WHERE pr.id = pe.produto_id),
+        'conferencia', (SELECT to_jsonb(ci) FROM public.entrega_conferencia_itens ci
+                        WHERE ci.entrega_id = p_entrega_id AND ci.etiqueta_id = pe.id)
+      )) ORDER BY pe.id)
+      FROM public.entrega_etiquetas ee
+      JOIN public.produto_etiquetas pe ON pe.id = ee.etiqueta_id
+      WHERE ee.entrega_id = p_entrega_id AND ee.ativo
+    ), '[]'::jsonb),
+    'checklist', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ck) ORDER BY ck.id)
+                           FROM public.entrega_checklist ck WHERE ck.entrega_id = p_entrega_id), '[]'::jsonb),
+    'ocorrencias', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(oc) ORDER BY oc.id)
+                             FROM public.entrega_ocorrencias oc WHERE oc.entrega_id = p_entrega_id), '[]'::jsonb),
+    'divergencias', coalesce((
+      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('etiqueta_id', ci.etiqueta_id, 'status', ci.status,
+                                          'quantidade', ci.quantidade, 'motivo', ci.motivo) ORDER BY ci.id)
+      FROM public.entrega_conferencia_itens ci
+      WHERE ci.entrega_id = p_entrega_id AND ci.status <> 'aceito'), '[]'::jsonb)
+  ))
+  INTO v
+  FROM public.entregas e
+  WHERE e.id = p_entrega_id;
+
+  IF v IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'entrega_nao_encontrada' USING ERRCODE = 'raise_exception';
+  END IF;
+  RETURN v;
+END $function$

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fin_dashboard_kpis(_from date, _to date)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE r jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
+  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+    'receitas_previstas', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(original_amount - COALESCE(received_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))
+        FROM accounts_receivable_installments WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to),0),
+    'receitas_realizadas', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_received) FROM receivable_payments WHERE payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to),0),
+    'despesas_previstas', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(original_amount - COALESCE(paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))
+        FROM accounts_payable_installments WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to),0),
+    'despesas_realizadas', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_paid) FROM payable_payments WHERE payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to),0),
+    'inadimplencia_total', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(original_amount - COALESCE(received_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))
+        FROM accounts_receivable_installments WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date),0),
+    'pagar_vencidas', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(original_amount - COALESCE(paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))
+        FROM accounts_payable_installments WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date),0),
+    'entregas_nao_faturadas_qtd', COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entregas WHERE financial_status='PENDING_BILLING' AND receivable_id IS NULL),0),
+    'entregas_nao_faturadas_valor', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.quantidade_entregue * p.valor_litro_brl) FROM entregas e
+        LEFT JOIN produtos p ON p.id = e.produto_id WHERE e.financial_status='PENDING_BILLING' AND e.receivable_id IS NULL),0),
+    'nfe_pendente_qtd', COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts_receivable WHERE fiscal_invoice_required=true AND fiscal_invoice_status='PENDING'),0),
+    'nfe_pendente_valor', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM accounts_receivable WHERE fiscal_invoice_required=true AND fiscal_invoice_status='PENDING'),0)
+  ) INTO r;
+  RETURN r;
+END $function$

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fiscal_item_profile_gate_eval(p_scope text, p_crt text, p_is_active boolean, p_profile_status text, p_accounting_validated_at timestamp with time zone, p_accounting_notes text, p_fiscal_description text, p_commercial_unit text, p_taxable_unit text, p_ncm text, p_origin_code text, p_cfop_in_state text, p_cfop_interstate text, p_icms_cst text, p_icms_csosn text, p_pis_cst text, p_cofins_cst text, p_regulatory jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ IMMUTABLE
+ SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_p jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;   -- pendências técnicas
+  v_reg jsonb := '[]'::jsonb; -- pendências regulatórias
+  v_na jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;  -- itens declarados NÃO APLICÁVEIS (com justificativa)
+  v_notes text := lower(coalesce(p_accounting_notes, ''));
+  v_synthetic boolean;
+  v_technical_ready boolean;
+  v_regulatory_ready boolean;
+  v_has_cst boolean := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_icms_cst,'')),'') IS NOT NULL;
+  v_has_csosn boolean := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_icms_csosn,'')),'') IS NOT NULL;
+  v_pend_count int;
+BEGIN
+  -- ---------------- Camada REGULATÓRIA (Fase F2) ----------------
+  -- Exigida apenas onde o dossiê existe como conceito: microrganismos.
+  IF p_scope <> 'MICROORGANISM' THEN
+    v_reg := '[]'::jsonb;
+  ELSIF p_regulatory IS NULL OR p_regulatory = 'null'::jsonb THEN
+    v_reg := jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+      'code','REGULATORY_DOSSIER_MISSING','field','microorganism_regulatory_dossiers','layer','REGULATORY',
+      'message','Sem dossie regulatorio cadastrado para o item.'));
+  ELSE
+    v_na := coalesce(p_regulatory->'checklist_not_applicable','[]'::jsonb);
+
+    IF coalesce(p_regulatory->>'status','') = 'BLOCKED' THEN
+      v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','REGULATORY_DOSSIER_BLOCKED','field','status','layer','REGULATORY',
+        'message', coalesce(p_regulatory->>'blocked_reason','Dossie regulatorio bloqueado.')));
+    ELSIF coalesce(p_regulatory->>'status','') <> 'VALIDATED' THEN
+      v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','REGULATORY_DOSSIER_NOT_PUBLISHED','field','status','layer','REGULATORY',
+        'message','Dossie regulatorio em '||coalesce(p_regulatory->>'status','?')||'; exigido VALIDATED.'));
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_regulatory->>'regulatory_category' IS NULL THEN
+      v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','REGULATORY_CATEGORY_MISSING','field','regulatory_category','layer','REGULATORY',
+        'message','Finalidade/categoria regulatoria nao definida (nao pode ser presumida pela especie).'));
+    END IF;
+    IF p_regulatory->>'strain' IS NULL THEN
+      v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','REGULATORY_STRAIN_MISSING','field','strain_code','layer','REGULATORY',
+        'message','Cepa/estirpe nao informada.'));
+    END IF;
+    IF p_regulatory->>'formulation' IS NULL THEN
+      v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','REGULATORY_FORMULATION_MISSING','field','formulation','layer','REGULATORY',
+        'message','Formulacao/apresentacao nao informada.'));
+    END IF;
+    IF p_regulatory->>'label_guarantee' IS NULL THEN
+      v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','REGULATORY_LABEL_GUARANTEE_MISSING','field','label_guarantee','layer','REGULATORY',
+        'message','Composicao/garantia de rotulo nao informada.'));
+    END IF;
+
+    -- MAPA: MISSING x NOT_APPLICABLE justificado x vencido
+    IF coalesce(p_regulatory->>'mapa_status','') = 'NOT_APPLICABLE' THEN
+      v_na := v_na || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'item_key','REGISTRO_MAPA','justification', p_regulatory->>'mapa_not_applicable_reason'));
+    ELSIF p_regulatory->>'mapa_registration_number' IS NULL THEN
+      v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','REGULATORY_MAPA_REGISTRATION_MISSING','field','mapa_registration_number','layer','REGULATORY',
+        'message','Registro MAPA/SIPEAGRO ausente e sem declaracao justificada de nao aplicabilidade.'));
+    ELSIF coalesce(p_regulatory->>'mapa_status','') IN ('EXPIRED','SUSPENDED') THEN
+      v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','REGULATORY_MAPA_REGISTRATION_INVALID','field','mapa_status','layer','REGULATORY',
+        'message','Registro MAPA em situacao '||(p_regulatory->>'mapa_status')||'.'));
+    ELSIF (p_regulatory->>'mapa_valid_until') IS NOT NULL
+          AND (p_regulatory->>'mapa_valid_until')::date < current_date THEN
+      v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','REGULATORY_MAPA_REGISTRATION_INVALID','field','mapa_valid_until','layer','REGULATORY',
+        'message','Registro MAPA com validade expirada.'));
+    END IF;
+    IF p_regulatory->>'mapa_holder' IS NULL AND coalesce(p_regulatory->>'mapa_status','') <> 'NOT_APPLICABLE' THEN
+      v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','REGULATORY_HOLDER_MISSING','field','mapa_holder','layer','REGULATORY',
+        'message','Titular/fabricante do registro nao informado.'));
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Documentos de evidência
+    IF coalesce((p_regulatory->>'has_label_document')::boolean,false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+      v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','REGULATORY_LABEL_DOCUMENT_MISSING','field','documents','layer','REGULATORY',
+        'message','Rotulo nao anexado ao dossie.'));
+    END IF;
+    IF coalesce((p_regulatory->>'has_report_document')::boolean,false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+      v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','REGULATORY_REPORT_DOCUMENT_MISSING','field','documents','layer','REGULATORY',
+        'message','Laudo/certificado de analise nao anexado ao dossie.'));
+    END IF;
+    IF coalesce((p_regulatory->>'expired_documents')::int,0) > 0 THEN
+      v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','REGULATORY_DOCUMENT_EXPIRED','field','documents','layer','REGULATORY',
+        'message',(p_regulatory->>'expired_documents')||' documento(s) com validade expirada.'));
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Aprovações separadas
+    IF coalesce(p_regulatory->>'review_technical','PENDING') <> 'APPROVED' THEN
+      v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','REGULATORY_TECHNICAL_APPROVAL_MISSING','field','technical_review_status','layer','REGULATORY',
+        'message','Revisao tecnica nao aprovada.'));
+    END IF;
+    IF coalesce(p_regulatory->>'review_regulatory','PENDING') <> 'APPROVED' THEN
+      v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','REGULATORY_RESPONSIBLE_APPROVAL_MISSING','field','regulatory_review_status','layer','REGULATORY',
+        'message','Revisao do responsavel tecnico (regulatoria) nao aprovada.'));
+    END IF;
+    IF coalesce(p_regulatory->>'review_fiscal','PENDING') <> 'APPROVED' THEN
+      v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','REGULATORY_FISCAL_APPROVAL_MISSING','field','fiscal_review_status','layer','REGULATORY',
+        'message','Revisao contabil/fiscal nao aprovada.'));
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Checklist
+    v_pend_count := jsonb_array_length(coalesce(p_regulatory->'checklist_pending','[]'::jsonb));
+    IF v_pend_count > 0 THEN
+      v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','REGULATORY_CHECKLIST_INCOMPLETE','field','checklist','layer','REGULATORY',
+        'message', v_pend_count||' item(ns) de checklist pendente(s).',
+        'items', p_regulatory->'checklist_pending'));
+    END IF;
+
+    -- NCM aprovado e coerente com o perfil fiscal
+    IF coalesce((p_regulatory->>'ncm_approved')::boolean,false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+      v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','REGULATORY_NCM_NOT_APPROVED','field','microorganism_ncm_candidates','layer','REGULATORY',
+        'message','Nenhum candidato de NCM aprovado; sugestao nunca vale como codigo aprovado.'));
+    ELSIF nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_ncm,'')),'') IS NOT NULL
+          AND p_regulatory->>'published_ncm' IS NOT NULL
+          AND p_regulatory->>'published_ncm' <> btrim(p_ncm) THEN
+      v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','REGULATORY_NCM_DIVERGES_FROM_PROFILE','field','ncm','layer','REGULATORY',
+        'message','NCM do perfil fiscal diverge do NCM publicado no dossie.'));
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Apresentações: unidades e GTIN exigem confirmação explícita
+    IF coalesce((p_regulatory->>'presentations_total')::int,0) = 0 THEN
+      v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','REGULATORY_PRESENTATION_MISSING','field','presentations','layer','REGULATORY',
+        'message','Nenhuma apresentacao cadastrada.'));
+    ELSE
+      IF coalesce((p_regulatory->>'presentations_units_unconfirmed')::int,0) > 0 THEN
+        v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+          'code','REGULATORY_UNITS_NOT_CONFIRMED','field','presentations.units','layer','REGULATORY',
+          'message',(p_regulatory->>'presentations_units_unconfirmed')||' apresentacao(oes) sem uCom/uTrib/fator confirmados.'));
+      END IF;
+      IF coalesce((p_regulatory->>'presentations_gtin_unconfirmed')::int,0) > 0 THEN
+        v_reg := v_reg || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+          'code','REGULATORY_GTIN_NOT_DECLARED','field','presentations.gtin','layer','REGULATORY',
+          'message',(p_regulatory->>'presentations_gtin_unconfirmed')||' apresentacao(oes) sem GTIN confirmado nem declaracao SEM GTIN.'));
+      END IF;
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- ---------------- Camada TÉCNICA (Fase F1, inalterada) ----------------
+  IF p_profile_status IS NULL THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+      'scope', p_scope, 'ready', false, 'technical_ready', false, 'regulatory_ready', false,
+      'status', 'NOT_READY', 'quarantined', false, 'profile_present', false,
+      'not_applicable', v_na,
+      'pendencies', jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','PROFILE_MISSING','field','profile_status','layer','TECHNICAL',
+        'message','Item sem perfil fiscal cadastrado.')) || v_reg);
+  END IF;
+
+  v_synthetic := v_notes LIKE '%sintetic%'
+              OR v_notes LIKE '%sintétic%'
+              OR v_notes LIKE '%homologacao%'
+              OR v_notes LIKE '%homologação%'
+              OR v_notes LIKE '%hml-b2b%'
+              OR v_notes LIKE '%test_only%'
+              OR v_notes LIKE '%quarentena%';
+
+  IF coalesce(p_is_active, false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+      'code','PROFILE_INACTIVE','field','is_active','layer','TECHNICAL','message','Perfil fiscal inativo.'));
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_profile_status = 'BLOCKED' THEN
+    v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+      'code','PROFILE_QUARANTINED','field','profile_status','layer','TECHNICAL',
+      'message','Perfil fiscal em quarentena (BLOCKED).'));
+  ELSIF p_profile_status <> 'VALIDATED' THEN
+    v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+      'code','PROFILE_NOT_PUBLISHED','field','profile_status','layer','TECHNICAL',
+      'message','Perfil fiscal nao publicado (exigido VALIDATED).'));
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_accounting_validated_at IS NULL THEN
+    v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+      'code','ACCOUNTING_NOT_VALIDATED','field','accounting_validated_at','layer','TECHNICAL',
+      'message','Sem validacao contabil preliminar registrada.'));
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_synthetic THEN
+    v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+      'code','PROFILE_SYNTHETIC','field','accounting_notes','layer','TECHNICAL',
+      'message','Classificacao sintetica de homologacao; nao utilizavel em faturamento.'));
+  END IF;
+
+  IF nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_fiscal_description,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
+    v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code','MISSING_FISCAL_DESCRIPTION','field','fiscal_description','layer','TECHNICAL','message','Descricao fiscal ausente.'));
+  END IF;
+  IF nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_commercial_unit,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
+    v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code','MISSING_COMMERCIAL_UNIT','field','commercial_unit','layer','TECHNICAL','message','Unidade comercial ausente.'));
+  END IF;
+  IF nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_taxable_unit,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
+    v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code','MISSING_TAXABLE_UNIT','field','taxable_unit','layer','TECHNICAL','message','Unidade tributavel ausente.'));
+  END IF;
+  IF nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_ncm,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
+    v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code','MISSING_NCM','field','ncm','layer','TECHNICAL','message','NCM ausente.'));
+  ELSIF p_accounting_validated_at IS NULL OR v_synthetic THEN
+    v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+      'code','NCM_NOT_ACCOUNTING_REVIEWED','field','ncm','layer','TECHNICAL',
+      'message','NCM sem revisao contabil preliminar (validacao contabil ausente ou perfil sintetico). Nao afirma nem substitui evidencia regulatoria.'));
+  END IF;
+  IF nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_origin_code,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
+    v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code','MISSING_ORIGIN_CODE','field','origin_code','layer','TECHNICAL','message','Codigo de origem ausente.'));
+  END IF;
+  IF nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_cfop_in_state,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
+    v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code','MISSING_CFOP_IN_STATE','field','cfop_in_state','layer','TECHNICAL','message','CFOP interno ausente.'));
+  END IF;
+  IF nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_cfop_interstate,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
+    v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code','MISSING_CFOP_INTERSTATE','field','cfop_interstate','layer','TECHNICAL','message','CFOP interestadual ausente.'));
+  END IF;
+  IF nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_pis_cst,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
+    v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code','MISSING_PIS_CST','field','pis_cst','layer','TECHNICAL','message','CST de PIS ausente.'));
+  END IF;
+  IF nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_cofins_cst,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
+    v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code','MISSING_COFINS_CST','field','cofins_cst','layer','TECHNICAL','message','CST de COFINS ausente.'));
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_has_cst AND v_has_csosn THEN
+    v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+      'code','CST_AND_CSOSN_CONFLICT','field','icms_cst,icms_csosn','layer','TECHNICAL',
+      'message','CST e CSOSN preenchidos simultaneamente; mutuamente exclusivos.'));
+  END IF;
+
+  IF nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_crt,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
+    v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+      'code','TAX_REGIME_UNKNOWN','field','company_fiscal_settings.crt','layer','TECHNICAL',
+      'message','CRT do emitente nao configurado.'));
+  ELSIF p_crt = '3' THEN
+    IF v_has_csosn THEN
+      v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','CSOSN_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_CRT3','field','icms_csosn','layer','TECHNICAL',
+        'message','CSOSN e exclusivo do Simples Nacional; emitente em CRT 3 (Regime Normal).'));
+    END IF;
+    IF NOT v_has_cst THEN
+      v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','CST_REQUIRED_FOR_CRT3','field','icms_cst','layer','TECHNICAL',
+        'message','CST de ICMS obrigatorio para CRT 3.'));
+    END IF;
+  ELSIF p_crt IN ('1','2') THEN
+    IF v_has_cst THEN
+      v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','CST_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_SIMPLES','field','icms_cst','layer','TECHNICAL',
+        'message','CST de ICMS nao se aplica a emitente do Simples Nacional.'));
+    END IF;
+    IF NOT v_has_csosn THEN
+      v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+        'code','CSOSN_REQUIRED_FOR_SIMPLES','field','icms_csosn','layer','TECHNICAL',
+        'message','CSOSN obrigatorio para CRT 1/2.'));
+    END IF;
+  ELSE
+    v_p := v_p || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
+      'code','TAX_REGIME_UNKNOWN','field','company_fiscal_settings.crt','layer','TECHNICAL',
+      'message','CRT do emitente com valor nao reconhecido.'));
+  END IF;
+
+  v_technical_ready := (jsonb_array_length(v_p) = 0);
+  v_regulatory_ready := (jsonb_array_length(v_reg) = 0);
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+    'scope', p_scope,
+    'ready', (v_technical_ready AND v_regulatory_ready),
+    'technical_ready', v_technical_ready,
+    'regulatory_ready', v_regulatory_ready,
+    'status', CASE WHEN (v_technical_ready AND v_regulatory_ready) THEN 'READY' ELSE 'NOT_READY' END,
+    'quarantined', (p_profile_status = 'BLOCKED'),
+    'profile_present', true,
+    'not_applicable', v_na,
+    'pendencies', v_p || v_reg);
+END
+$function$
